## History

Hammond lived up the river with his wife, where he operated a small sawmill. Together with his wife, he raised a family of eight children. After residing up the river for over two years, Hammond passed away, which led to his wife breaking up their household.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)_
